text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding anything that could go wrong. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might buy insurance or train your staff. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup plans in case the main plan fails. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because risks can change over time. By following these steps, you can protect your project or business and feel more confident about the future.
